about: B-79. Two floors, each with one collider standing on it and one swordsman beside it. `warriors` is where check:fight (rule 5) stands the warrior for each: across the collider, inside the swordsman's sight, so the straight line he closes along runs through it. Not a playable level and not linted as one: only `geometry` and `enemies` are read, as src/systems/fight.ts reads a level.
